natural_power_continuous.source:
import Mathlib

example : ∀ (n : ℕ), Continuous (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)))
  | succ n ih => simpa only [pow_succ, Pi.mul_apply, id_eq] using ih.fun_mul continuous_id

2.tail: theorem pals_recipe_instance : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) := pals_recipe_general 2

3.tail: theorem pals_recipe_instance : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3) := pals_recipe_general 3
